pages.title: Take to the Skies
pages.text: After finishing the first 2 chapters of this Simulation. You can create the $(item)Glitch Infused$() armor set.$(br2)This will bestow the wearer with creative flight, among other benefits.

pages.title: Enderference Tools
pages.text: Crafting tool parts out of $(item)Endstone$() produces parts that have the $(item)Enderference$() trait. It will prevent $(l:sim_4/inhabitants)Endermen$() from teleporting away.$(br2)We recommend putting it on a Broadsword and/or on a Shuriken.
A great upgrade to the drawers. The $(item)Black Hole Unit$() can hold a near infinite amount of one type of item.
A great upgrade to the portable tanks. The $(item)Black Hole Tank$() can hold a near infinite amount of one type of liquid.

pages.title: Black Hole Controller
pages.text: The $(item)Black Hole Controller$() can hold multiple $(item)Black Hole Tanks$() or $(item)Black Hole Units$() inside.

pages.title: Meat Feeder
pages.text: Ever feel tired of eating? With the $(item)Advanced PCBs$() unlocked early on in this simulation, you can make a gadget that automatically feeds you liquid meat.$(br2)Perfect for long arduous battles!
